name: hud_ui_message_box_dialog_destructor
description: HudUiMessageBoxDialog::Destructor frees the fallback background pixels/image, tears down message-box buttons, panels, backdrop widget, and then delegates to HudUiBackground teardown.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4bf560 yet; current evidence is functional only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x4bf560 validates the message-box vtable reset, fallback background pixel free before zVid_Image::Destroy, child teardown order, and final HudUiBackground::Destructor call.
The native message-box destructor smoke constructs the fallback dialog, invokes Destructor, and verifies background image clearing plus button/backdrop/base teardown state.
